negative_guards.note: Official page existence does not prove parcel applicability.
Service query capability is not a point-intersection response.
A layer title does not prove the canonical point intersects it.
A child-layer cache miss must not be filled with inferred metadata.
A deterministic URL is not a live result.
The complete raw response body must be preserved.
The exact request URL must have a SHA-256.
The raw response body must have a SHA-256.
Each live response needs a UTC fetch timestamp.
Each live response needs an HTTP status.
Each live response needs its response content type.
JSON must parse successfully before semantic interpretation.
ArcGIS or Planning Data API error objects are not results.
A zero result applies only to the queried source and dataset.
Point-only data cannot be treated as an affected polygon.
Indicative Opportunity Area boundaries need borough confirmation.
Emerging or draft policy is not adopted policy.
AMR, HDT and borough programmes remain area-level proxies.
Positive and constraining intersections must be reconciled.
Score and confidence remain null/zero until primary cross-check passes.

crosschecks.note: Medium-growth and Green Belt layers must both be queried and reconciled.
Examination-stage plan evidence cannot be treated as adopted allocation.
National brownfield evidence needs local-register polygon confirmation.
Adopted 2021 allocations and evidence-stage update must stay distinct.
Proposed station and safeguarding evidence must be separately intersected.
Register boundaries are not definitive without exact geometry.
Inspector report does not by itself prove adopted site allocation.
Opportunity Area boundary is indicative and requires borough confirmation.
Council polygon service result must be preserved and cross-checked.

system_validations.note: All external URLs use official council, GLA, Planning Data or canonical GitHub hosts.
The 60 query jobs are uniquely identified.
Thirty child-layer fetch attempts remain blocked/unknown rather than invented.
Five newly added pages have explicit source-level quality classifications.
No missing or zero result is generalized to no constraint.
All unbound rows keep score null and confidence zero.
No business row is emitted without exact binding and cross-check.
